transportability_release.authorized_scope: Prespecified global linear acceleration-summary interaction tests only.
transportability_release.level_estimates_role: Context within the supported family; no pairwise ranking, causal, biological, or threshold claim.
guardrails: Stage 2 established strong acceleration nonlinearity; Stage 3 interactions concern only the frozen global linear summary.
Modified-Poisson fitted values above one are not probabilities.
Race/ethnicity is a social classification and must not be framed as innate biological difference.
Subgroup estimates must not be used to rank individuals or groups.

prediction_release.authorized_wording: Adding canonical Phenotypic Age acceleration produced a modest improvement in pooled out-of-cycle prediction within NHANES 2015-2018 beyond age, sex, and race/ethnicity.
guardrails: This is bidirectional cross-cycle validation within NHANES, not independent external-cohort validation.
The governed cycle-specific acceleration definition is assumed available in each evaluation cycle.
No decision-curve, treatment-threshold, or clinical-utility claim is authorized.
No participant-level prediction or individual risk tool is released.
